title: Twelve French letters in undeciphered cipher signs, three addressed to 'Nathanael Siluer' (Rakoczi's alias), one to Kortholt at Danzig, 1708
correspondents: unknown writers → Francis II Rakoczi as 'Nathanael Siluer'; → Kortholt (Danzig); others unnamed
shelfmark: MNL OL, G 15 (II. Rakoczi Ferenc fejedelem leveltara, Emigracioba vitt resz), Caps. A1, Fasc. 11, fol. 111-111/a, 112-112/a, 113-113/a, 114-114/a, 120-121/a, 122-124, 125-128, 129-129/a, 130-130/a, 131-131/a, 134, 135-136/a
status: MNL item records: 'vegig megfejtetlen titkos jegyekkel' (wholly in undeciphered secret signs) or 'nagyreszt megfejtetlen titkos jegyekkel'. Not on DECODE (DECODE holds G 15 Caps. C Fasc. 23/33/36/39/43/44, D 80-81, E 109, H 226, J 256 only).
why: A run of 1708 letters to Rakoczi under his cover name, at the time of the Polish-Russian negotiations; the largest undeciphered group in the prince's own archive.
score_note: Scored from the archive's item description during the 11 Nov 2026 MNL AdatbazisokOnline sweep (research/sweep_2026-11-11_southeast/); not viewed (no images online)
verify: Order scans of A1 Fasc. 11 fol. 111-136; compare the signs with DECODE's Rakoczi French keys (G 15 Caps. C Fasc. 43-44) and with the Non-decrypted R902 (Pompeio Cesoni, Caps. C Fasc. 39 fol. 277-279).
